title: Ringed local open-closed short exact sequence
statement: Let i:Z to X be a closed immersion with complementary quasi-compact open object U [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let A be any commutative ring sheaf. For actual module inverse image and direct image through the ring-unit action [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and the specified sheafified extension presheaf [def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf, def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification], let ai and aj be any adjunctions to their indicated right adjoints. At every A-module sheaf M, aj.counit(M) is monic, ai.unit(M) is epic, and the composable pair is exact [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence].

proof.text: Use the affine open cover of an arbitrary pro-etale object. Refine each affine by the bounded faithfully flat weakly etale ring extension having ring retractions. These same-universe singleton covers compose with the affine cover.

The inverse image of the closed support is closed in Spec R; its complement is compact because the complementary open immersion is quasi-compact. Compact-open classification yields a finite set s with V(span s) equal to this support. The closed-localization covering for J=span s consists of the basic opens D(s_j) and the localization at elements invertible modulo J. The latter ring has the retraction property, hence section-surjectivity of every set-sheaf epimorphism; all its points specialize into the closed support. Pullback points identify this support with the closed fibre.

On a piece mapping to U, the open immersion makes U subterminal. Consequently Over.forget U is full, its unit is invertible, and the counit of the restriction/right-direct-image adjunction overPushforwardOverAdj is invertible. The adjoint-triple criterion therefore makes the unit of the supplied extension/restriction adjunction invertible. Its triangle identity makes the restricted counit invertible; evaluation at the given lift to U gives sectionwise bijectivity. The closed pullback is empty on this piece, so its module sections vanish by the empty sheaf axiom.

On the closed-localization piece the sheafified extension presheaf has zero sections: locally represent a sheafified section, refine so each piece specializes into the closed fibre, and every lift to U then has empty source. Its direct-sum presheaf section vanishes by the empty sheaf axiom, so separatedness kills the section. The actual module closed unit is bijective by the module specialization theorem.

Covering transitivity combines these refinements. On each piece the first section map is injective, the second is surjective, and their image/kernel condition holds because one end is zero and the other map bijective. Sheaf separatedness descends injectivity and the zero composite; local surjectivity gives epimorphisms. Apply the same local lifting argument to the kernel lift to prove exactness in the abelian module category.

theorem proEtale_ringed_localization_sequence {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (U : X.ProEt) [IsOpenImmersion U.hom] [QuasiCompact U.hom]
    (hU : Set.range U.hom = (Set.range i)ᶜ)
    (A : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (ai : proEtaleModuleInverseImage i A ⊣
      (SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u + 1} (F := proEtaleBaseChange i)
      (J := ProEt.topology X) (K := ProEt.topology Z)
      (S := ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj A)) (R := ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology Z)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj
        ((proEtaleSheafInverseImage i CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj A)))
      ⟨Functor.whiskerRight
        ((proEtaleSheafAdjunction i CommRingCat.{u + 1}).unit.app A).hom
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})⟩))
    (aj : (SheafOfModules.extensionByZeroPresheaf.{u + 1} ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj A) U ⋙
      PresheafOfModules.sheafification (𝟙 ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj A).obj)) ⊣
      SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u + 1} ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj A) U) :
    ∀ M, Mono (aj.counit.app M) ∧ Epi (ai.unit.app M) ∧
      (ComposableArrows.mk₂ (aj.counit.app M) (ai.unit.app M)).Exact
